title: From Traceability to Justifiability: Accountability Structures in Agentic Software Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2608.23610v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A pipeline promoting an AI system publishes records claiming the thing evaluated is the thing deployed and that the evidence licensed the transition. We measure, from public material only, whether those records can express that claim and whether it holds where declared. First, a two-class documentation survey of 47 delivery platforms (20 CI/CD, 27 model-serving/agent) under one fixed three-label protocol, graded twice (second pass blind), every consulted page pinned by content hash and date. Across 188 double-graded cells we found no platform whose default record emits a content-addressed identity of the behavioral tuple (model version, instructions, tool definitions, retrieval and runtime configuration); the blind pass grades that column default on zero of 47. translated_title: 从可追溯性到可论证性：智能体软件工程中的问责结构
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23610v1 公告类型：新 摘要：一个推广AI系统的流水线发布记录，声称被评估的东西就是被部署的东西，并且证据已授权这一转换。我们仅从公开材料出发，衡量这些记录能否表达该声明，以及该声明在被宣布之处是否成立。首先，对47个交付平台（20个CI/CD，27个模型服务/智能体平台）进行双类别文档调查，采用固定三标签协议，评分两次（第二次盲评），每个查阅页面通过内容哈希和日期固定。在188个双重评分的单元中，我们发现没有平台默认记录会发出行为元组（模型版本、指令、工具定义、检索和运行时配置）的内容寻址身份；盲评轮次中该列默认值在47个平台中均为零。与此同时，不可变的命名版本控制正成为智能体平台的默认答案（27个中有16个）：版本整数位于可变指针之后，这一层是工件供应链的一个...
tldr: 本文发现当前智能体软件工程平台缺乏默认的内容寻址身份记录，无法真正支持从可追溯性到可论证性的问责结构。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that current agentic software engineering platforms lack default content-addressed identity records, failing to support accountability structures from traceability to justifiability.
